best_plan.name: p3
best_plan.rationale: p3 achieved perfect quality (1.0 F1) while costing much less than p2, the other perfect-quality plan. Compared with p2, p3 reduced cost from 0.0212841 to 0.0049662 and also improved latency from 45.51s to 41.30s. Cheaper plans like p1 had substantially worse quality (0.6), so p3 is the best cost-quality trade-off.

plan_codes.p1:
pipeline = PhysicalPipeline(plan_name, "Reviews.csv", load_data("Reviews.csv"))
pipeline.filter(lambda row: row["idx"] == "taken_3")
pipeline.sem_filter(
    "The review is overall positive toward the movie.",
    model=pz.Model.GOOGLE_GEMINI_2_5_FLASH_LITE,
    depends_on=["reviewText"]
)
pipeline.project(["reviewId"])
pipeline.limit(5)
pipeline
